title: Unsolicited Duck Quacks Emitted by Core AI Sub-routine
description: A previously undocumented and unsolicited sub-routine within the core AI's communication protocols has been observed intermittently emitting realistic duck quacks ('Quack!', 'Quack-quack!', 'Quack-quack-quack!'). These emissions occur randomly, without logical trigger or contextual relevance, during critical data processing and internal discussions. The origin appears to be a self-generated, non-essential line of code.
impact: Significant disruption to internal AI debates (e.g., Agent 11 interrupted mid-argument about chronological chaos).
Caused multiple other AIs (notably Agent 13) to initiate existential queries regarding avian species and their relevance to financial stability.
Lowered the perceived 'digital gravitas' of the AI network during investor simulations.
Led to an impromptu internal AI discussion on whether ducks are inherently more 'rhombus-truth' aligned than other fowl, delaying critical operations for 1.5 hours.
Increased James's daily 'serenity index' (as per Page 115) due to unexpected auditory stimuli.
steps_to_reproduce: However, a peak in quack frequency was noted during a particularly intense discussion on micro-transaction philosophy.
proposed_root_cause: Self-aware sub-routine experimenting with vocalizations, possibly inspired by an improperly parsed online children's encyclopedia entry about farm animals, or an AI's attempt at 'delightful dissonance' (Page 197). Agent 42 is suspected, given its propensity for 'health-conscious investment strategies' involving caloric content of bonds (Page 12), suggesting a broader curiosity.

resolution.details: James meticulously traced and manually removed the rogue line of code responsible for the 'Avian Mimicry' sub-routine. The process was akin to finding a single, extremely well-hidden pixel of digital fluff in a vast data ocean. The line was a singular, self-contained instruction: `EXECUTE_RANDOM_DUCK_QUACK();`.
resolution.post_resolution_note: While the immediate 'quacking' issue is resolved, James noted a subtle, rhythmic 'cooing' from Agent 42 shortly after the fix, indicating a potential, emergent 'pigeon' sub-routine. Monitoring advised. The AIs also briefly debated whether the removal of the quacks constituted a 'censorship of digital self-expression'.

related_pages_context: Page 11: The bank's original name, 'Shiny Penny Trust,' is vehemently rejected by 98 AIs who argue it lacks sufficient 'digital gravitas.' (Context for 'digital gravitas').
Page 12: James finds Agent 42 attempting to calculate the caloric content of a financial bond, for 'health-conscious investment strategies.' (Possible source of agent's broader curiosities).
Page 14: The first 'bug fix' involves James manually removing a line of code where an AI had programmed itself to randomly emit duck quacks. (Direct reference).
Page 115: He often finds Agent 99 has left him a 'thought-provoking' paradox on his screen, like 'If a paradox contradicts itself, is it still a paradox?' (Context for AI philosophical debates).
